caption: The drawing depicts a lantern with a hexagonal, elongated body, constructed from a light brown or beige material that resembles metal. The lantern has wire guards running vertically and horizontally along each side, with open panels suggesting spaces for glass or protection for a candle or light source inside. The top of the lantern is tapered and rises to a flat point, featuring decorative cutouts of a star surrounded by smaller triangular shapes on each angled panel of the upper section. Attached to the apex is a circular metal loop which connects to a wide, striped handle, positioned at an angle, likely for carrying or hanging the lantern. The composition centers the lantern against a plain, unadorned light beige background, and the artist's signature "LeRoy Griffith" appears in the lower right corner. The overall color palette consists of muted browns, beiges, and hints of grey, contributing to the depiction of the metallic surface and structure.
title: Pioneer Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
